name: Mary Gardner
bioAdditions: Mary (Warren), widow Gardner, daughter of Thomas Warren of Southwold, was Rev. John Youngs's third wife, probably married at Salem about 1639. She died at Southold in 1678 (S1). Not ancestral.

sources.citation: Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations)

researchLogEntry: Round 4: identified from Youngs 1907; wife of Rev. John Youngs, not ancestral.
